### TYPE: SOP

(4)  District  Magistrates  will  carefully  protect  and  control  the  Patels.  Charges  of  neglect  of

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: Mujhe pata chala hai ki hamare gaon ke patel ne apni duty mein negligence ki hai. Unhone ek case ko investigate nahi kiya aur ab woh case bada ho gaya hai. Maine district magistrate ko complaint ki hai lekin ab tak koi action nahi hua hai. Maine 5000 rupaye bhi diye the patel ko lekin woh bhi gayab ho gaye hai.
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I have come to know that our village patel has been negligent in his duty. He did not investigate a case and now the case has become big. I have complained to the district magistrate but no action has been taken yet. I had also given 5000 rupees to the patel but that has also disappeared.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: Mujhe apni shikayat darj karwani hai ki mere pati, Rohan, ne mujhe aur mere parivaar ko dhokha diya hai. Unhone mere naam par ek bank account khulwaya tha, jiske baad unhone us account se paise nikalne ke liye ek VPA/UPi ka upyog kiya. Maine dekha ki unhone mere phone ka upyog karke ek ajnabi mahila se sampark kiya tha, jiske baad unhone mujhe aur mere parivaar ko dhyan se hataya. Maine police ko shikayat darj karayi, lekin ab tak koi karyawahi nahin hui hai. Maine suna hai ki police ko ek warrant jari karna hoga, lekin mujhe nahin pata ki yeh kaise hoga. Maine ek application bhi di thi ki mere pati ke khilaf ek case darj kiya jaye, lekin ab tak koi sunwai nahin hui hai.
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint that my husband, Rohan, has cheated me and my family. He opened a bank account in my name and then used a VPA/UPi to withdraw money from that account. I saw that he used my phone to contact a stranger woman, after which he ignored me and my family. I filed a complaint with the police, but no action has been taken yet. I heard that the police need to issue a warrant, but I don't know how this will happen. I also submitted an application to register a case against my husband, but so far, no hearing has taken place.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: Mujhe apni shikayat darj karwani hai ki mere ghar par kuchh ajeeb aadmi aaye the, jinhone mere parivaar ko dhमकaya aur mere ghar mein ghuse aaye (Section 329, BNS). Maine police ko phone kiya, lekin ve aane mein deri kar rahe the (Section 221, BNSS). Jab police aayi, to unhone pata lagaya ki ye aadmi mere business rival ke saath milkar mere khilaf saazish kar rahe the (Section 221, BNSS). Maine police ko ye bhi bataya ki ye log mere khilaf pichhle kuchh dinon se kai saazish kar rahe the, jismein mere ghar par hamla bhi shamil hai (Section 2, Chapter XXXV, BNSS). Maine police se anurodh kiya hai ki ve is mamle ki jaanch karein aur mere parivaar ki suraksha sunishchit karein. Maine police ko ye bhi bataya ki maine is mamle mein kuchh kharcha kiya hai, jismein travelling allowance aur daily allowance bhi shamil hai (Appendix VIII, The Gujarat Police Manual).
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint that some suspicious men came to my house, threatened my family, and trespassed into my home (Section 329, BNS). I called the police, but they were delayed in responding (Section 221, BNSS). When the police arrived, they found out that these men were conspiring against me with my business rival (Section 221, BNSS). I told the police that these men had been conspiring against me for the past few days, including an attack on my house (Section 2, Chapter XXXV, BNSS). I requested the police to investigate this matter and ensure my family's safety. I also informed the police that I had incurred some expenses in this matter, including traveling allowance and daily allowance (Appendix VIII, The Gujarat Police Manual).

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: Mujhe apne bete ki shikaayat karni hai, jiske khilaf ek ship wreck ke maamlon mein captain ne protest kiya tha, lekin ab uska attendance nahi ho raha hai. Iske alawa, mere bete ka personal data bhi leak ho gaya hai, jiske liye maine DPDP Act ke tahat shikaayat ki hai. Maine apne bete ke computer system ko acquire karne ke liye BPRD First Responder Handbook ka paalan kiya hai, lekin ab mujhe pata chala hai ki usmein kuchh galat transactions hui hain. Maine Gujarat Police Manual ke mutabik apne bete ke bank account aur vpa/upi transactions ki jaanch karwai hai, lekin ab mujhe lagta hai ki yeh sab ek bada scam hai.
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint against my son, who is involved in a ship wreck case where the captain had made a protest, but now his attendance is not possible. Additionally, my son's personal data has been leaked, for which I have filed a complaint under the DPDP Act. I followed the BPRD First Responder Handbook to acquire my son's computer system, but now I have found some incorrect transactions. I have investigated my son's bank account and vpa/upi transactions as per the Gujarat Police Manual, but now I think this is a big scam.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: मैं शिकायत दर्ज कराना चाहता हूँ कि मेरे खिलाफ कुछ लोगों ने मिलकर मेरे ऑनलाइन बैंक अकाउंट से पैसे निकाल लिए हैं और मुझे धमकी दे रहे हैं कि अगर मैंने पुलिस में शिकायत की तो वे मेरे खिलाफ फर्जी मामले दर्ज करा देंगे। मैंने अपने बैंक अकाउंट की जानकारी किसी को नहीं दी थी, लेकिन फिर भी मेरे अकाउंट से पैसे निकाले गए हैं। मैं संदेह करता हूँ कि यह मामला साइबर क्राइम से जुड़ा हो सकता है और मेरे खिलाफ कुछ लोगों ने मिलकर यह अपराध किया है। मैं चाहता हूँ कि पुलिस इस मामले की जाँच करे और दोषियों को सजा दिलाए। मेरे पास एक वीडियो रिकॉर्डिंग है जिसमें आरोपियों की आवाजें हैं और वे मुझे धमकी दे रहे हैं।
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint that some people have conspired against me and withdrawn money from my online bank account, and are now threatening me that if I file a complaint with the police, they will file false cases against me. I had not shared my bank account information with anyone, but still, money was withdrawn from my account. I suspect that this case may be related to cybercrime and that some people have committed this crime against me. I want the police to investigate this case and punish the culprits. I have a video recording in which the voices of the accused are heard and they are threatening me.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: मैं रोहन गुप्ता हूँ, मेरे पिता का नाम राजेश गुप्ता है और हम लोग अहमदाबाद में रहते हैं। मेरे पिता के खिलाफ एक शिकायत दर्ज की गई थी जिसमें उन पर धोखाधड़ी का आरोप लगाया गया था। लेकिन जब मैं और मेरे पिता अदालत में गवाही देने के लिए उपस्थित हुए, तो हमने पाया कि आरोपी ने हमें धमकी दी थी और हमें अदालत में गवाही देने से रोकने की कोशिश की। इसके अलावा, आरोपी ने मेरे पिता के खिलाफ ऑनलाइन धोखाधड़ी की थी और उनके बैंक खाते से पैसे निकाले थे। हमने इसकी शिकायत साइबर सेल में दर्ज कराई थी। साथ ही, आरोपी ने मेरे पिता की संपत्ति को भी हड़पने की कोशिश की थी, जिसे हमने अदालत में चुनौती दी थी।
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I am Rohan Gupta, my father's name is Rajesh Gupta and we live in Ahmedabad. A complaint was filed against my father in which he was accused of cheating. But when my father and I appeared in court to testify, we found that the accused had threatened us and tried to prevent us from testifying in court. Additionally, the accused had committed online fraud against my father and withdrawn money from his bank account. We had filed a complaint about this with the cyber cell. Also, the accused had tried to usurp my father's property, which we had challenged in court.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: Mujhe pata chala hai ki mere ghar se kuch saman chori ho gaya hai, jismein mere passport, Aadhar card, aur kuch peise the. Maine police ko report kiya, lekin unhone mujhe bataya ki yeh case Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ke Section 317 ke tahat aata hai, jo chori ki saman ko prapt karne ke bare mein hai. Abhi tak, koi arrest nahi hua hai, lekin police ne mujhe bataya ki ve Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) ke Chapter XXIX ke tahat appeal kar sakte hain. Maine apne bank account ka bhi detail diya hai, jismein kuch suspicious transaction hui hain. Maine Gujarat Police Manual ke mutabik, District Magistrate ko bhi report kiya hai, taaki ve is case ko carefully protect aur control kar sakein.
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I have found out that some items have been stolen from my house, including my passport, Aadhar card, and some cash. I reported it to the police, but they told me that this case falls under Section 317 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), which deals with receiving stolen property. So far, no one has been arrested, but the police told me that they can appeal under Chapter XXIX of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS). I have also provided details of my bank account, which has some suspicious transactions. I have also reported this to the District Magistrate as per the Gujarat Police Manual, so that they can carefully protect and control this case.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: मैं रोहन, मुंबई का निवासी हूँ, मेरे साथ धोखाधड़ी हुई है। मैंने एक नौकरी के लिए अप्लाई किया था, जिसमें मुझे एक व्यक्ति ने फोन किया और मुझे नौकरी दिलाने के लिए 50,000 रुपये देने को कहा। मैंने पैसे दे दिए, लेकिन बाद में पता चला कि यह एक फर्जी नौकरी थी। मैंने इसकी शिकायत पुलिस में की, लेकिन उन्होंने मेरी शिकायत दर्ज नहीं की। मैंने डीपीडीपी एक्ट के तहत भी शिकायत की, क्योंकि मेरे व्यक्तिगत डेटा का दुरुपयोग किया गया था। मैं चाहता हूँ कि इस मामले में उचित कार्रवाई की जाए और मेरे पैसे वापस मिलें।
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I, Rohan, a resident of Mumbai, have been a victim of fraud. I had applied for a job, and a person called me, asking for 50,000 rupees to secure the job. I paid the money, but later found out it was a fake job. I complained to the police, but they didn't register my complaint. I also filed a complaint under the DPDP Act, as my personal data was misused. I want proper action to be taken in this case and my money back.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: Mujhe apni shikayat darj karwani hai ki mere khilaf ek vyakti ne mere bank account ka misuse kiya hai, jiske liye maine RBI ke KYC/AML guidelines ke anusaar apna account update kiya tha. Lekin usne mere account se paise transfer kar liye aur ab wo vyakti mujhe dhमकia rahe hain ki agar maine police ko bataya to wo mere khilaf court mein case darj karwa denge. Maine use samjhaane ki koshish ki ki wo galat kar rahe hain lekin wo nahin maane. Maine dekha ki usne mere account se paise transfer karne ke liye ek fake email id aur mobile number ka use kiya tha, jiske liye usne IT Act ke tahat foreign certifying authority ka bhi misuse kiya tha. Iske alawa, usne mere khilaf ek motor vehicle chalate hue prohibition offense bhi kiya tha, jiske liye maine Gujarat police manual ke hisaab se police ko suchit kiya tha. Lekin ab tak koi action nahin hua hai.
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint that someone has misused my bank account, for which I had updated my account according to RBI's KYC/AML guidelines. But they transferred money from my account and now they are threatening me that if I tell the police, they will file a case against me in court. I tried to explain to them that they are doing wrong, but they are not listening. I saw that they used a fake email id and mobile number to transfer money from my account, for which they also misused foreign certifying authority under the IT Act. Additionally, they committed a prohibition offense while driving a motor vehicle, for which I informed the police according to the Gujarat police manual. But no action has been taken yet.
synthetic_complaint.crime_sub_type: Cybercrime, Financial Fraud, Prohibition Offense, and Threats

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: Mujhe pata hai ki ek aadmi, jiska naam Rajesh hai, ne apne business partner, Ramesh ko Dubai mein maar dala. Rajesh ne yeh crime karne ke baad, India mein wapas aaya aur court mein Ramesh ki maut ke baare mein jhoothi gawaahi di. Usne kaha ki Ramesh ki maut ek accident mein hui thi. Lekin sachchai yeh hai ki Rajesh ne Ramesh ko maarne ke liye ek planned conspiracy ki thi. Rajesh ne Ramesh ke bank account se paise transfer karne ke liye ek fake letter banaya tha, jismein Ramesh ka signature nakal karke lagaya tha. Iske alawa, Rajesh ne apne ghar mein ek COVID-19 patient ko chhupaaya tha, jiske kaaran uske parivaar ke kai log bimaar ho gaye. Main is complaint ko darj karne ke liye yahaan hoon, kyunki mujhe lagta hai ki Rajesh ne kai saare crimes kiye hain, jismein murder, false evidence, forgery aur negligence bhi shaamil hain.
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I know that a man named Rajesh murdered his business partner, Ramesh, in Dubai. After committing the crime, Rajesh returned to India and gave false testimony in court about Ramesh's death, saying it was an accident. However, the truth is that Rajesh had planned a conspiracy to kill Ramesh. Rajesh created a fake letter to transfer money from Ramesh's bank account, forging Ramesh's signature. Additionally, Rajesh hid a COVID-19 patient in his home, resulting in several family members falling ill. I am filing this complaint because I believe Rajesh has committed multiple crimes, including murder, false evidence, forgery, and negligence.
synthetic_complaint.crime_sub_type: Murder, False Evidence, Forgery, and Negligence

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: मैं शिकायत दर्ज कराना चाहता हूँ कि मेरे पिता जी की मृत्यु के बाद, उनके नौकर ने उनके सामान और पैसे पर कब्जा कर लिया और सरकारी स्टाम्प वाले दस्तावेजों को भी नष्ट कर दिया। इसके अलावा, उन्होंने अवैध तरीके से एकत्र होकर मेरे घर में आग लगा दी और मेरे परिवार को धमकी दी। मैंने पुलिस को सूचित किया, लेकिन उन्होंने अभी तक कोई कार्रवाई नहीं की है। मैं चाहता हूँ कि इस मामले में जल्द से जल्द कार्रवाई की जाए और दोषियों को सजा मिले।
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint that after my father's death, his servant took possession of his belongings and money, and also destroyed documents bearing government stamps. Moreover, they unlawfully assembled and set fire to my house, threatening my family. I informed the police, but they have not taken any action yet. I want action to be taken in this matter as soon as possible and the culprits to be punished.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: मैं शिकायत दर्ज कराना चाहता हूँ कि मेरे साथ धोखाधड़ी हुई है और मुझे ऑनलाइन ठगा गया है। मैं एक सरकारी अधिकारी हूँ और मेरे पास एक बैंक अकाउंट है जिसका नंबर 1234567890 है और IFSC कोड है ABCD1234। मेरे पास एक व्यक्ति ने मुझसे संपर्क किया और मुझे बताया कि मेरा अकाउंट हैक हो गया है और मुझे अपना पासवर्ड बदलना होगा। मैंने उन्हें अपना पासवर्ड दे दिया और अब मेरे अकाउंट से पैसे निकाल लिए गए हैं। मैंने उन्हें फोन किया तो उन्होंने मुझे धमकी दी और कहा कि अगर मैंने पुलिस में शिकायत दर्ज की तो वे मुझे मार देंगे। मैंने पुलिस स्टेशन में जाकर शिकायत दर्ज कराई लेकिन उन्होंने मुझे बताया कि यह मामला साइबर क्राइम के तहत आता है और वे इस मामले को देखेंगे।
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint that I have been cheated and scammed online. I am a government official and I have a bank account with account number 1234567890 and IFSC code ABCD1234. A person contacted me and told me that my account has been hacked and I need to change my password. I gave them my password and now money has been withdrawn from my account. When I called them, they threatened me and said that if I file a complaint with the police, they will kill me. I went to the police station and filed a complaint, but they told me that this case falls under cyber crime and they will look into it.

synthetic_complaint.raw_text: मैं शिकायत दर्ज कराना चाहता हूँ कि मेरी बहन के साथ एक संगठित अपराध सिंडिकेट के सदस्य ने बलात्कार किया है और हमारे घर में घुसकर हमारी संपत्ति को नुकसान पहुँचाया है। आरोपी ने हमारे घर को तोड़कर घुसपैठ की और हमारी बहन को जबरन अपने साथ ले गया। हमने पुलिस में रिपोर्ट दर्ज कराई है और आरोपी के खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई चाहते हैं। आरोपी के पास हमारी बहन को धमकी देने के लिए कई मोबाइल नंबर और बैंक खाते हैं जिनका उपयोग वह हमारी बहन को धमकाने के लिए करता है।
synthetic_complaint.translated_text: I want to file a complaint that a member of an organized crime syndicate has committed rape with my sister and has trespassed into our house, causing damage to our property.
